cards.card_text: When Israel enters the land He's giving them and reaps its harvest, they bring the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of that harvest.
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.
cards.snippet: …harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.

cards.card_text: From their homes, Israel brings two loaves of bread as firstfruits to the LORD.
cards.verse_text: Bring two loaves of bread from your dwellings as a wave offering, each made from two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as the firstfruits to the LORD.
